subject: CAIQ: control ownership lifecycle + sample provisioning plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novushealth.com
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: control ownership lifecycle + sample provisioning plan

Hi team —

NovusHealth sent back the CAIQ with a heavier-than-usual ask for runtime proofs: they want a clear owner for each control, a short narrative for any compensating controls, and a small sample bundle for a subset of controls we touch at the inference layer (auth, key management, telemetry, tenant isolation).

Proposal:
- I will draft a one-line owner + responsibility for each control we own (G1–G5) and mark any controls that map to shared responsibility (platform vs. infra).
- Marissa — can you pull the current control-owner roster and export the control trace columns into the shared Drive folder? Prefer an XLSX with columns: control_id, current_owner, redwood_component, evidence_type, sample_path.
- Kimberly — can you stage a small telemetry sample (7-day slice, redacted) and a KV/key-rotation excerpt? Novus only needs one tiny runtime snippet plus a README; avoid full logs.

Deadlines: owner roster by Tue EOD PDT (2026-09-01), artifacts staged by Wed morning (2026-09-02). I will assemble the CAIQ response package and add a short narrative for any compensating controls.

Attachments: initial template (caiq-control-owner-roster.xlsx) attached — fill the current_owner and sample_path columns.

Thanks — this should close the bulk of their mapping questions quickly.

—Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations (on rotation)
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control ownership lifecycle + sample provisioning plan

Irene — thanks, will do.

Quick notes: I pulled the current roster and reconciled it with the service ownership list. A few items need minor updates (service mesh owner changed for a11y boundary). I uploaded a working copy to the Drive link and added owner names for the inference-related controls.

I can't attach the full sheet here (PII), but I'm sending the exported columns you asked for into the shared folder. Filename: caiq-control-owner-roster_v1.xlsx (in Drive).

Action items I took:
- Populated control_id / current_owner / redwood_component.
- For shared controls (networking, cloud KMS) I set current_owner to the platform team and added a note in the comments column.

I'll complete the sample_path entries after Kimberly confirms artifact locations.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Aug 2026 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control ownership lifecycle + sample provisioning plan

Heads up — I can stage two small artifacts for Novus:
1) runtime-telemetry-snippet.tar.gz — this will contain a 24-hour redacted sequence of request/response traces, scrubbed for PII and hashed IDs.
2) kms-rotation-excerpt.txt — summary of the last rotation event with timestamps (no key material).

I uploaded both to the staging bucket and added links in the Drive sheet under sample_path for the relevant controls. My note: confirm whether Novus wants time-windowed traces (they asked for 7-day slice in the original email) — we can provide a 24-hour sanitized sample now and offer a rolling 7-day brief if they need it for audit.

Attachment stub: runtime-telemetry-snippet.tar.gz (contains: README.md, traces.jsonl.gz (redacted), scrub_log.txt)

Kimberly
Principal SRE, Observability
Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novushealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ: control ownership lifecycle + sample provisioning plan

Thanks all — this is perfect.

A couple asks from Novus security:
- The 24-hour redacted trace is fine as an initial artefact; please include a short README that lists redaction rules (what was hashed/removed).
- Could we schedule a 30-minute walkthrough early next week to review the owner roster and the mapping decisions? Wed or Thu (PDT) works for our audit team.

If you can share the Drive link with view-only access to security@novushealth.com, we'll validate the sample and confirm next steps.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Senior InfoSec Manager
NovusHealth
